name: civitai-block-starter
description: Vite + TypeScript starter for building Civitai Apps — iframe-embedded UIs on civitai.com pages — with web components and no UI framework.
comment-overrides: SECURITY CONSTRAINTS ON TRANSITIVE DEPENDENCIES. Declared HERE, in the
starter's own manifest, because that is what travels: `npx tiged
this directory alone, and the monorepo root's pnpm.overrides is NOT part of
the copy -- so a constraint kept only there protects the monorepo and nothing
a developer actually runs. NEITHER ENTRY HAS A REFERENT IN THIS STARTER
TODAY (it resolves no `cookie`, and no `postcss` below 8.5.10); both are
mirrored anyway so the rule stays mechanical rather than a hand-kept
exception list. BOTH blocks on purpose: `overrides` is npm's key and
`pnpm.overrides` is pnpm's -- pnpm does not read the plain key. Inside the
workspace pnpm warns `This will not take effect` for this file; that is
correct (only the root's overrides apply there) and not a reason to delete it.
